segments.an7.82:1.1: “Sattahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato [samannāgato bhikkhu (ka.)] vinayadharo sobhati.
segments.an7.82:1.3: Āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ, dvepi jātiyo … pe … iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena … pe … āsavānaṃ khayā … pe … sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.an7.82:1.10: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatī”ti.
